description: Save a digest — a snapshot of the user's work across Notion, GitHub, GitLab, git and docket that YOU compiled after actually reading those sources — so it shows on the Docket dashboard and syncs to the user's paired devices. Load the docket:digest skill for how to build one. Digests are immutable: publish a new one rather than editing. Put structure in fields, not in the summary: every PR/MR/ticket is an item with url, ref, status and tone, and anything the user must act on gets attention:true.

highlights.description: Up to 12 one-line takeaways, most important first

metrics.description: Up to 8 headline numbers, e.g. {label:"MRs merged", value:3, tone:"good"}

tone.description: Colour cue: good (merged/done), warn (waiting/stale), bad (failing/blocked), info, neutral

sections.description: Grouped items, up to 300 in total. Put the "needs you" group first.

group.description: The area this section belongs to, e.g. "Work" or "Side projects". Sections with the same group are shown together under one heading; the digest skill's config says which repos go where

attention.description: True when the user has to act: review it, unblock it, reply

detail.description: Markdown, only for items worth more than a line — blocked, failing, stale, a decision: what is actually wrong, what was tried, the next step. Leave it out for routine items

kind.description: pr (GitHub), mr (GitLab), issue, ticket (Notion/Jira), commit, release, todo, doc, mail (an email thread), chat (a Slack/Teams thread), note

note.description: One line of your judgement: why it matters or what changed

owner.description: Who does the next step: "you" (the user), "agent" (you, the agent, as a follow-up), or a person's name from the digest config

status.description: As the source says it: merged, open, In review, Blocked…

tone.description: Colour cue: good (merged/done), warn (waiting/stale), bad (failing/blocked), info, neutral

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the item's last change at the source

url.description: http(s) link to the item — always set it when there is one

sources.description: Every source you tried, including the ones that failed, e.g. {name:"gitlab", ok:true, detail:"9 MRs in acme/*"}

summary.description: Markdown, 2–6 sentences: what matters, what changed since the last digest, what to do next

title.description: Short heading, e.g. "Fri 4 Oct — 2 MRs await review, ACME-680 blocked"

windowFrom.description: Start of the period covered, ISO date or timestamp

windowTo.description: End of the period covered, ISO date or timestamp

name: digest_publish
title: Publish digest
